findings.message: Entity "User" has no explicit read, create, update, delete access rule. Omitted entity rules allow access at the policy layer; other authorization may still restrict it.
findings.suggestion: Declare access rules for every operation to make the intended boundary explicit.

findings.message: Page "/initiatives/:id" query "initiative" has no explicit positive result limit.
findings.suggestion: Set a limit appropriate for the view to bound work as the dataset grows.
